# About me

I am a first-year Economics PhD student at the joint program of [Barcelona School of Economics](https://bse.eu/) and [Universitat Pompeu Fabra](https://www.upf.edu/).

Previously, I worked at the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS), where I developed a keen interest in labor market transitions and social protection policy. My research has drawn on labor economics and applied econometrics to shed light into public policy.
